## Description
Please include a summary of the change, relevant context, and which issue it fixes (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly with `cargo build`
- [ ] All unit tests pass with `cargo test`
- [ ] Formatting is verified with `cargo fmt -- --check`
- [ ] Linter is clean with `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly
